No per-article verification was demonstrated. This is a clear, unjustified inference that directly produces the wrong final result. No later step corrects this assumption; instead, Step 21 repeats the same faulty conclusion. Thus, Step 19 is the first mistake that led to the final wrong outcome and was not corrected afterward.
